assertion_origin: Independent pristine-input authoring; no repair-plan or patch inspection
native_target: Rocky Linux 8/aarch64, non-root, Python >=3.12, GCC, glibc-2.28-251.el8_10.48.aarch64
rate_interpretation: x2 wall-clock deltas bounded using unfaked monotonic request/response intervals; no scheduler-rate or sub-millisecond precision claim
initial_offset: +60 x2 bounded from unfaked exec release, ready receipt and sample bracket with 100ms slack; startup delay is measured rather than guessed

negative_cut.otherwise: NOT ESTABLISHED; no changed assertions, loader-error substitution or retry

stat.legacy_abi: _STAT_VER from target glibc headers; compile fails if unavailable
stat.fixed_timestamps: all three exactly fixed_date_epoch_ns_UTC; observer's actual times unchanged

top_level_guard: Unfaked gate reports actual PID/start token; current overrides empty; both own-PID paths ENOENT; then exec same PID
descendant_guard: Loaded child reports actual PID/start token and current getenv FAKETIME_SHARED; exact living-parent pair dev/inode/mode/uid/gid exists before and after exec; own-PID paths ENOENT; same PID/start token and parentage
positive_shm_proof: Current getenv exact creator-PID pair AND observed rw-s mapping with matching dev/inode; successful exit alone insufficient
unfaked_prerequisite: Perl Time::HiRes import/version output then exactly two finite increasing numeric monotonic readings, exit 0 and empty stderr

upstream.normal_exits: external strace process receipts for all eight timetest execs and section-7 date; make status 0 additionally required
upstream.signal_marker: one or more exact target SIGUSR1 lines per timetest section after gettimeofday; no fixed upper count or stricter clock/stat interleaving
upstream.progress: ten exact source prefixes, once each, in order in each timetest section
upstream.allocator_diagnostics: complete pristine libmallocintercept lines only in sections 8-9, optional; record fd0; corrupted markers/out-of-memory/abort fail
upstream.date_output: exactly one valid C-locale UTC date line in section 7
upstream.streams: stdout and stderr merged chronologically and both classified
upstream.pre_gate_inventory: all /dev/shm names, namespace/tmpfs identity, ns_last_pid, pid_max; any faketime or sem.* name, or new negative-control temporary name, stops gate without deletion or PID hunting
